WITH txns AS (
  SELECT f.CHNL_K, dt.CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL ch ON f.CHNL_K = ch.CHNL_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT ch.CHNL_K, ch.DSPLY_NM, COUNT(*) AS txn_count
FROM txns t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL ch ON t.CHNL_K = ch.CHNL_K
GROUP BY ch.CHNL_K, ch.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY txn_count DESC;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_customers FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST WHERE IS_ACTV = TRUE;

WITH alerts AS (
  SELECT a.JUR_K, d.CAL_YR_NBR
  FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction, COUNT(*) AS alert_count
FROM alerts a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY alert_count DESC;

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT d_br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name, d_dt.CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR d_br ON f.BR_K = d_br.BR_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
  WHERE d_dt.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT branch_name, COUNT(*) AS txn_count
FROM txn
GROUP BY branch_name
ORDER BY txn_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CUST_K) AS num_clients_default
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D
WHERE DFLT_FLG = TRUE
  AND BUS_DT_K = (SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT = '2025-08-31');

WITH complaints AS (
  SELECT f.CMPLT_CTG_K, d_dt.CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
  WHERE d_dt.CAL_DT >= '2025-01-01' AND d_dt.CAL_DT <= '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT d.CMPLT_CTG_K,
       d.DSPLY_NM,
       COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM complaints c
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG d ON c.CMPLT_CTG_K = d.CMPLT_CTG_K
GROUP BY d.CMPLT_CTG_K, d.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.CUST_K) AS clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.DFLT_FLG = TRUE
  AND d.CAL_DT = '2023-08-31';

SELECT f.CCY_CD1 AS currency, AVG(f.AVRG_RT) AS avg_daily_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY f.CCY_CD1;

SELECT ACCT_TYP_CD1 AS account_type_code,
       COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM OPND_DT) = 2025
GROUP BY ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY ACCT_TYP_CD1;

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT f.BR_K, d.CTY_NM, COUNT(*) AS txn_cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR d ON f.BR_K = d.BR_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE dt.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-03-31'
  GROUP BY f.BR_K, d.CTY_NM
)
SELECT CTY_NM, SUM(txn_cnt) AS atm_txn_count
FROM txn
GROUP BY CTY_NM
ORDER BY atm_txn_count DESC;

SELECT AVG(CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = '2025-06-30';

WITH fx AS (
  SELECT f.MID_RT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE f.CCY_CD1 = 'USD'
    AND d.MTH_NBR = 12
    AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT AVG(MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate
FROM fx;

WITH disputes AS (
  SELECT d.MTH_NBR, COUNT(*) AS dispute_cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
)
SELECT MTH_NBR, dispute_cnt
FROM disputes
ORDER BY MTH_NBR;

SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment, COUNT(DISTINCT CUST_K) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY segment;

WITH cust_with_txn AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST d ON f.CUST_K = d.CUST_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
), all_cust AS (
  SELECT CUST_K FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_no_txn_2025
FROM all_cust a
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cust_with_txn c WHERE c.CUST_K = a.CUST_K);

WITH auth AS (
  SELECT PMT_STS_CD1
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS declined_pct
FROM auth;

WITH f AS (
  SELECT f.CMPLT_CTG_K, f.IS_ESCLT, d.CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE f.IS_ESCLT = TRUE
    AND d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT c.DSPLY_NM AS category_name, COUNT(*) AS escalated_count
FROM f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG c ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = c.CMPLT_CTG_K
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY escalated_count DESC;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT f.FEE_AMT, c.CHNL_K, c.DSPLY_NM, dt.CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON f.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM dt.CAL_DT) = 2025
)
SELECT DSPLY_NM AS channel_name, SUM(FEE_AMT) AS total_fees
FROM t
GROUP BY DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY total_fees DESC;

SELECT SUM(f.TXN_AMT) AS total_fraud_txn_amt
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH a AS (
  SELECT a.AML_ALRT_F_K, a.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1, a.JUR_K, d_dt.CAL_DT, d_jur.DSPLY_NM
  FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR d_jur ON a.JUR_K = d_jur.JUR_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON a.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
  WHERE a.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d_dt.CAL_DT) = 2025
)
SELECT DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name, COUNT(*) AS high_severity_alerts
FROM a
GROUP BY DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY high_severity_alerts DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS loans_over_90
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D dlq
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON dlq.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = '2025-08-31'
  AND dlq.DYS_PST_DUE > 90;

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR AS year
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL ch ON f.CHNL_K = ch.CHNL_K
  WHERE ch.DSPLY_NM ILIKE '%Mobile App%'
)
SELECT year, COUNT(*) AS txn_count
FROM txn
WHERE year IN (2024,2025)
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year;

SELECT d.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product, SUM(f.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT) AS total_outstanding
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD d ON f.LN_PRD_K = d.LN_PRD_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT = '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY d.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY total_outstanding DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.CUST_K) AS distinct_customers
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K=d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K=c.CUST_K
WHERE f.IS_CRSS_BRDR=true
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR=2025
  AND c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1='SME';

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT d_br.RGN_CD1, d_br.DSPLY_NM, f_atm_txn.BR_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f_atm_txn
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR d_br ON f_atm_txn.BR_K = d_br.BR_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f_atm_txn.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
  WHERE d_dt.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT RGN_CD1, DSPLY_NM, txn_count
FROM (
  SELECT RGN_CD1, DSPLY_NM, COUNT(*) AS txn_count,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RGN_CD1 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
  FROM txn
  GROUP BY RGN_CD1, DSPLY_NM
) t
WHERE rn = 1;

WITH auth AS (
  SELECT a.ORGNL_AMT, m.MRCH_CTG_CD1, d.CAL_YR_NBR
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_MRCH m ON a.MRCH_K = m.MRCH_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT MRCH_CTG_CD1, SUM(ORGNL_AMT) AS total_amount
FROM auth
GROUP BY MRCH_CTG_CD1
ORDER BY total_amount DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT f.CUST_K, f.STLM_AMT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT c.BUS_ID, SUM(t.STLM_AMT) AS total_amount
FROM t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
GROUP BY c.BUS_ID
ORDER BY total_amount DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT d.CCY_CD1,
       SUM(CAST(f.AMT AS NUMERIC(20,4))) AS total_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

WITH wire AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
), atm AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers
FROM (
  SELECT CUST_K FROM wire
  INTERSECT
  SELECT CUST_K FROM atm
) t;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfers_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025;

SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS year, COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR;

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT d.IS_WKND
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025
)
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN IS_WKND THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS weekend_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN NOT IS_WKND THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS weekday_count
FROM txn;

WITH bal AS (
  SELECT ACCT_K, BUS_DT_K, CLSNG_BAL_AMT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D
  WHERE BUS_DT_K IN (
    SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT IN ('2025-12-31','2025-06-30')
  )
),
  dec AS (
    SELECT a.ACCT_K
    FROM bal a
    JOIN bal b ON a.ACCT_K = b.ACCT_K
    WHERE a.BUS_DT_K = (SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT='2025-12-31')
      AND b.BUS_DT_K = (SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT='2025-06-30')
      AND a.CLSNG_BAL_AMT < 0.9 * b.CLSNG_BAL_AMT
  )
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_accounts FROM dec;

WITH c AS (
  SELECT d.DSPLY_NM AS category,
         EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (f.RSLTN_AT - f.CNTCT_STRTD_AT))/86400 AS days
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG d ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = d.CMPLT_CTG_K
  WHERE f.IS_RSLVD = true
    AND DATE_TRUNC('year', f.RSLTN_AT) = DATE '2025-01-01'
)
SELECT category, AVG(days) AS avg_days
FROM c
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY avg_days;

WITH curr AS (
  SELECT * FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST WHERE IS_CURR = true
), prev AS (
  SELECT * FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST WHERE IS_CURR = false
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS diff_count
FROM curr c
JOIN prev p
  ON c.CUST_K = p.CUST_K
 AND p.VRSN_NBR = c.VRSN_NBR - 1
WHERE c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 <> p.CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

WITH txns AS (
  SELECT f.CUST_K, d.QTR_NBR
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers
FROM (
  SELECT CUST_K
  FROM txns
  GROUP BY CUST_K
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT QTR_NBR) = 4
) t;

WITH disputes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT d
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
), transfers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF t
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON t.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers
FROM disputes d
LEFT JOIN transfers t ON d.CUST_K = t.CUST_K
WHERE t.CUST_K IS NULL;

WITH d4 AS (
  SELECT LN_ID, DYS_PST_DUE
  FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D fd
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON fd.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT = '2024-06-30'
), d5 AS (
  SELECT LN_ID, DYS_PST_DUE
  FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D fd
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON fd.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT = '2025-06-30'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM d4
JOIN d5 USING (LN_ID)
WHERE d4.DYS_PST_DUE = 0 AND d5.DYS_PST_DUE > 30;

WITH transfers AS (
  SELECT CCY_CD1, STLM_AMT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT CCY_CD1,
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY STLM_AMT) AS median_amount
FROM transfers
GROUP BY CCY_CD1
ORDER BY CCY_CD1;

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR, COUNT(*) AS txn_cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON f.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE c.CHNL_TYP_CD1 = 'MOBILE'
  GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
)
SELECT (t2025.txn_cnt::numeric / t2024.txn_cnt - 1)*100 AS pct_growth
FROM txn t2024
JOIN txn t2025 ON t2024.CAL_YR_NBR = 2024 AND t2025.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH last_snap AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', snap_tmstm)::date AS month_start,
         max(snap_tmstm) AS last_snap
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D
  WHERE snap_tmstm >= '2025-01-01' AND snap_tmstm < '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY 1
), balances AS (
  SELECT l.month_start, sum(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS total_closing
  FROM last_snap l
  JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
    ON f.snap_tmstm = l.last_snap
  GROUP BY l.month_start
)
SELECT month_start, total_closing
FROM balances
ORDER BY month_start;

WITH cust2025 AS (
  SELECT CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
  WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
    AND CUST_SNC_DT >= '2025-01-01'
    AND CUST_SNC_DT < '2026-01-01'
), tx2025 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_customers
FROM cust2025 c
JOIN tx2025 t ON c.CUST_K = t.CUST_K;

WITH active AS (
  SELECT CUST_K, CUST_SGMNT_CD1
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
  WHERE EFF_FRM_DT <= DATE '2023-06-30'
    AND (EFF_TO_DT IS NULL OR EFF_TO_DT > DATE '2023-06-30')
)
SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment, COUNT(DISTINCT CUST_K) AS customer_count
FROM active
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY segment;

WITH transfers AS (
  SELECT c.CUST_K,
         c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1,
         c.BUS_ID,
         SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_amt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    AND c.IS_CURR = true
  GROUP BY c.CUST_K, c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1, c.BUS_ID
), ranked AS (
  SELECT *,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1 ORDER BY total_amt DESC) AS rn
  FROM transfers
)
SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1,
       BUS_ID,
       total_amt
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1, rn;

WITH transfers AS (
  SELECT CCY_CD1
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT CCY_CD1,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / NULLIF(total.total_cnt,0),2) AS pct
FROM transfers
CROSS JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_cnt FROM transfers) total
GROUP BY CCY_CD1, total.total_cnt
ORDER BY pct DESC;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT d.MTH_NBR, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
)
SELECT m.MTH_NBR,
       COALESCE(t.cnt,0) AS wire_transfers,
       SUM(COALESCE(t.cnt,0)) OVER (ORDER BY m.MTH_NBR) AS running_total
FROM generate_series(1,12) AS m(MTH_NBR)
LEFT JOIN t ON t.MTH_NBR = m.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY m.MTH_NBR;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT f.ORGNL_AMT::numeric AS amt,
         f.ORGNL_CCY_CD1 AS ccy,
         d.CAL_DT AS bus_date,
         d.DT_K AS bus_dt_k
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN t.ccy='EUR' THEN t.amt
                ELSE t.amt / fx.MID_RT END) AS total_eur
FROM t
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D fx
  ON fx.BUS_DT_K = t.bus_dt_k
  AND fx.BS_CCY_CD1='EUR'
  AND fx.QUOT_CCY_CD1 = t.ccy;

WITH auth AS (
  SELECT d.MTH_NBR,
         CASE WHEN f.RJCTN_RSN_CD1 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS declined
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT MTH_NBR AS month_number,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(declined)::numeric / COUNT(*) ,2) AS decline_pct
FROM auth
GROUP BY MTH_NBR
ORDER BY decline_pct DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT CCY_CD1 AS currency, SUM(STLM_AMT) AS total_volume
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF
WHERE BUS_DT_K IN (
  SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
GROUP BY CCY_CD1
ORDER BY total_volume DESC;

WITH txns AS (
  SELECT a.CHNL_K, d.CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON a.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT c.DSPLY_NM AS channel, COUNT(*) AS txn_count
FROM txns t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON t.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY txn_count DESC;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_customers FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST WHERE IS_ACTV = TRUE;

WITH alerts AS (
  SELECT a.JUR_K, d.CAL_YR_NBR
  FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction, COUNT(*) AS alert_count
FROM alerts a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY alert_count DESC;

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT d_br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name, d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR d_br ON f.BR_K = d_br.BR_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
  WHERE d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT branch_name, COUNT(*) AS txn_count
FROM txn
GROUP BY branch_name
ORDER BY txn_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT C.CUST_K) AS num_clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D D
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST C ON D.CUST_K = C.CUST_K
WHERE D.DFLT_FLG = TRUE
  AND D.BUS_DT_K = 20250831;

SELECT c.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category,
       COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG c ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = c.CMPLT_CTG_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC;

WITH last_aug AS (
  SELECT DT_K
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE CAL_DT = '2023-08-31'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.CUST_K) AS num_clients_default
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D d
JOIN last_aug la ON d.BUS_DT_K = la.DT_K
WHERE d.DFLT_FLG = TRUE;

WITH d AS (
  SELECT DT_K, CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAL_DT) = 2025
)
SELECT
  f.CCY_CD1 AS currency,
  AVG(f.AVRG_RT) AS avg_daily_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY currency;

SELECT ACCT_TYP_CD1 AS account_type_code,
       COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM OPND_DT) = 2025
GROUP BY ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY ACCT_TYP_CD1;

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT b.CTY_NM AS city, f.*
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b ON f.BR_K = b.BR_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-03-31'
)
SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count
FROM txn
GROUP BY city
ORDER BY atm_txn_count DESC;

SELECT AVG(CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = '2025-06-30';

WITH fx AS (
  SELECT f.MID_RT, d.CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE f.CCY_CD1 = 'USD'
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025
    AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM d.CAL_DT) = 12
)
SELECT AVG(MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate
FROM fx;

SELECT d.MTH_NBR AS month, COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR;

SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment, COUNT(DISTINCT CUST_K) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = true
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY customer_count DESC;

WITH cust AS (
  SELECT CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
  WHERE IS_CURR = true
), txns AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ON F_ACCT_TXN.BUS_DT_K = D_DT.DT_K
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM D_DT.CAL_DT) = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_no_txn
FROM cust
LEFT JOIN txns USING (CUST_K)
WHERE txns.CUST_K IS NULL;

WITH auth AS (
  SELECT PMT_STS_CD1
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS declined_pct
FROM auth;

SELECT d.DSPLY_NM AS category_name, COUNT(*) AS escalated_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG d ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = d.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 AND f.IS_ESCLT = true
GROUP BY d.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY escalated_count DESC;

SELECT SUM(f.TXN_AMT) AS total_fraud_txn_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD'
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025;

WITH f AS (
  SELECT j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE a.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025
  GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
)
SELECT * FROM f;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT LN_ID) AS loans_over_90
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT = '2025-08-31' AND d.DYS_PST_DUE > 90;

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT f.BUS_DT_K, f.CHNL_K, COUNT(*) AS txn_cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE f.CHNL_K = 3
  GROUP BY f.BUS_DT_K, f.CHNL_K
)
SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS year, SUM(txn.txn_cnt) AS mobile_app_txns
FROM txn
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON txn.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR;

SELECT d.LN_PRD_K,
       d.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product_name,
       SUM(f.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT) AS total_outstanding_principal
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD d ON f.LN_PRD_K = d.LN_PRD_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT = '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY d.LN_PRD_K, d.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY total_outstanding_principal DESC;

WITH dt AS (
    SELECT DT_K
    FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAL_DT) = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.CUST_K) AS distinct_customers
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
WHERE f.IS_CRSS_BRDR = TRUE
  AND c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'SME';

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT d_br.RGN_CD1 AS region_code,
         d_br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
         COUNT(*) AS txn_count
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR d_br ON f.BR_K = d_br.BR_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
  WHERE d_dt.CAL_DT BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY d_br.RGN_CD1, d_br.DSPLY_NM
)
SELECT region_code, branch_name, txn_count
FROM (
  SELECT region_code, branch_name, txn_count,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region_code ORDER BY txn_count DESC) AS rn
  FROM txn
) t
WHERE rn = 1;

WITH auth AS (
  SELECT a.ORGNL_AMT, d.MRCH_CTG_CD1
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_MRCH d ON a.MRCH_K = d.MRCH_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON a.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT MRCH_CTG_CD1 AS merchant_category_code,
       SUM(ORGNL_AMT) AS total_amount
FROM auth
GROUP BY MRCH_CTG_CD1
ORDER BY total_amount DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT f.CUST_K, SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_amt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY f.CUST_K
)
SELECT c.BUS_ID, t.total_amt
FROM t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
ORDER BY t.total_amt DESC
LIMIT 5;

WITH d AS (
  SELECT DT_K
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT
  CCY_CD1,
  SUM(CAST(AMT AS NUMERIC(20,4))) AS total_amt
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF
WHERE BUS_DT_K IN (SELECT DT_K FROM d)
GROUP BY CCY_CD1
ORDER BY total_amt DESC;

WITH wire AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wt
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON wt.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
), atm AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN at
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON at.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers
FROM (
  SELECT CUST_K FROM wire
  INTERSECT
  SELECT CUST_K FROM atm
) sub;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfers_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR, f.WR_TRF_F_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
)
SELECT CAL_YR_NBR AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT WR_TRF_F_K) AS wire_transfers
FROM t
WHERE CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024,2025)
GROUP BY CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY CAL_YR_NBR;

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.IS_WKND THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS weekend_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN NOT d.IS_WKND THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS weekday_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH bal AS (
  SELECT f.ACCT_K, f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT, d.CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT IN ('2025-06-30','2025-12-31')
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_accounts
FROM (
  SELECT a.ACCT_K
  FROM bal a
  JOIN bal b ON a.ACCT_K = b.ACCT_K
  WHERE a.CAL_DT = '2025-12-31'
    AND b.CAL_DT = '2025-06-30'
    AND a.CLSNG_BAL_AMT < b.CLSNG_BAL_AMT * 0.9
) sub;

WITH c AS (
  SELECT d.DSPLY_NM AS category,
         EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (f.RSLTN_AT - f.CNTCT_STRTD_AT))/86400 AS days
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG d ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = d.CMPLT_CTG_K
  WHERE f.IS_RSLVD = true
    AND DATE_TRUNC('year', f.RSLTN_AT) = DATE '2025-01-01'
)
SELECT category, ROUND(AVG(days),2) AS avg_days
FROM c
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY avg_days;

WITH curr AS (
  SELECT CUST_K, CUST_SGMNT_CD1, VRSN_NBR
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
  WHERE IS_CURR
), prev AS (
  SELECT CUST_K, CUST_SGMNT_CD1, VRSN_NBR
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
  WHERE NOT IS_CURR
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT curr.CUST_K) AS changed_segments
FROM curr
JOIN prev
  ON curr.CUST_K = prev.CUST_K
 AND curr.VRSN_NBR = prev.VRSN_NBR + 1
WHERE curr.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 <> prev.CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

WITH txns AS (
  SELECT f.CUST_K, d.QTR_NBR
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_with_all_quarters
FROM (
  SELECT CUST_K
  FROM txns
  GROUP BY CUST_K
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT QTR_NBR) = 4
) t;

WITH disputes_2025 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
), wire_2025 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers
FROM disputes_2025 d
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wire_2025 w WHERE w.CUST_K = d.CUST_K);

WITH d4 AS (
  SELECT LN_ID FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D fd
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON fd.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT = '2024-06-30' AND fd.DYS_PST_DUE = 0
), d5 AS (
  SELECT LN_ID FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D fd
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON fd.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT = '2025-06-30' AND fd.DYS_PST_DUE > 30
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM d4
WHERE LN_ID IN (SELECT LN_ID FROM d5);

WITH transfers AS (
  SELECT CCY_CD1, STLM_AMT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT CCY_CD1 AS currency,
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY STLM_AMT) AS median_amount
FROM transfers
GROUP BY CCY_CD1
ORDER BY CCY_CD1;

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR AS year, d_chnl.DSPLY_NM
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL d_chnl ON f.CHNL_K = d_chnl.CHNL_K
  WHERE d_chnl.DSPLY_NM ILIKE '%mobile app%'
)
SELECT ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN year=2025 THEN cnt END)-SUM(CASE WHEN year=2024 THEN cnt END))::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN year=2024 THEN cnt END),0)*100,1) AS pct_growth
FROM (
  SELECT year, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM txn
  GROUP BY year
) t;

WITH last_snap AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', SNAP_TMSTM)::date AS month_start,
         MAX(SNAP_TMSTM) AS last_snap
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM SNAP_TMSTM)=2025
  GROUP BY 1
), balances AS (
  SELECT ls.month_start,
         SUM(CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS total_closing
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
  JOIN last_snap ls ON f.SNAP_TMSTM = ls.last_snap
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT month_start, total_closing
FROM balances
ORDER BY month_start;

WITH cust2025 AS (
  SELECT CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
  WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CUST_SNC_DT) = 2025
), tx2025 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_customers
FROM cust2025 c
WHERE c.CUST_K IN (SELECT CUST_K FROM tx2025);

WITH valid AS (
  SELECT CUST_K, CUST_SGMNT_CD1
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
  WHERE DATE '2023-06-30' BETWEEN EFF_FRM_DT AND COALESCE(EFF_TO_DT, DATE '9999-12-31')
)
SELECT COALESCE(CUST_SGMNT_CD1, 'UNKNOWN') AS segment,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CUST_K) AS customer_count
FROM valid
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY segment;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT d.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment,
         d.BUS_ID,
         SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_amt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST d ON f.CUST_K = d.CUST_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    AND d.IS_CURR = true
  GROUP BY d.CUST_SGMNT_CD1, d.BUS_ID
)
SELECT segment, BUS_ID, total_amt
FROM (
  SELECT segment, BUS_ID, total_amt,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY segment ORDER BY total_amt DESC) AS rn
  FROM base
) t
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY segment, rn;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT CCY_CD1, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY CCY_CD1
), total AS (
  SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_cnt FROM t
)
SELECT CCY_CD1,
       ROUND(100.0 * cnt / total_cnt, 2) AS pct
FROM t, total
ORDER BY pct DESC;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT d.MTH_NBR,
         COUNT(*) AS month_count
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
)
SELECT MTH_NBR,
       month_count,
       SUM(month_count) OVER (ORDER BY MTH_NBR) AS running_total
FROM t
ORDER BY MTH_NBR;

WITH conv AS (
  SELECT f.WR_TRF_F_K,
         f.ORGNL_AMT,
         f.ORGNL_CCY_CD1,
         f.BUS_DT_K,
         CASE WHEN f.ORGNL_CCY_CD1 = 'EUR' THEN f.ORGNL_AMT
              ELSE f.ORGNL_AMT / fx.MID_RT END AS amt_eur
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D fx
    ON fx.BUS_DT_K = f.BUS_DT_K
   AND fx.QUOT_CCY_CD1 = f.ORGNL_CCY_CD1
   AND fx.BS_CCY_CD1 = 'EUR'
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON d.DT_K = f.BUS_DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT SUM(amt_eur) AS total_eur FROM conv;

WITH f AS (
  SELECT f.STLM_AMT, f.CCY_K, d.CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025
)
SELECT c.CCY_CD1 AS currency, SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_volume
FROM f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY c ON f.CCY_K = c.CCY_K
GROUP BY c.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY total_volume DESC;

SELECT ch.CHNL_K, ch.DSPLY_NM, COUNT(*) AS txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL ch ON f.CHNL_K = ch.CHNL_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ch.CHNL_K, ch.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY txn_count DESC;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_customers FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST WHERE IS_ACTV = TRUE;

WITH alerts AS (
  SELECT a.JUR_K, d.DSPLY_NM, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM dt.CAL_DT) AS yr
  FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR d ON a.JUR_K = d.JUR_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON a.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM dt.CAL_DT)=2025
)
SELECT DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction, COUNT(*) AS alert_count
FROM alerts
GROUP BY DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY alert_count DESC;

WITH counts AS (
  SELECT d_br.BR_K,
         d_br.DSPLY_NM,
         d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR,
         COUNT(*) AS txn_count
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR d_br ON f.BR_K = d_br.BR_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
  WHERE d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY d_br.BR_K, d_br.DSPLY_NM, d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR
)
SELECT * FROM counts ORDER BY txn_count DESC;

WITH d AS (
  SELECT DT_K
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT dps
JOIN d ON dps.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CUST_K) AS num_clients_default
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D d
WHERE d.DFLT_FLG = TRUE
  AND d.BUS_DT_K = (SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT = '2025-08-31');

WITH d AS (
  SELECT DT_K, CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT
  c.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category,
  COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG c ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = c.CMPLT_CTG_K
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CUST_K) AS clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.DFLT_FLG = TRUE
  AND d.CAL_DT = '2023-08-31';

WITH d AS (
  SELECT DT_K
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT
  f.CCY_CD1 AS currency,
  AVG(f.AVRG_RT) AS avg_daily_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY avg_daily_rate DESC;

SELECT ACCT_TYP_CD1 AS account_type_code,
       COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM OPND_DT) = 2025
GROUP BY ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY ACCT_TYP_CD1;

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT f.BR_K, b.CTY_NM, COUNT(*) AS txn_cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b ON f.BR_K = b.BR_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-03-31'
  GROUP BY f.BR_K, b.CTY_NM
)
SELECT CTY_NM, SUM(txn_cnt) AS atm_txn_count
FROM txn
GROUP BY CTY_NM
ORDER BY atm_txn_count DESC;

SELECT AVG(CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = '2025-06-30';

SELECT AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.CCY_CD1 = 'USD'
  AND d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-12-01' AND '2025-12-31';

SELECT d.MTH_NBR AS month,
       COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR;

SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment, COUNT(DISTINCT CUST_K) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = true
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY segment;

WITH cust_with_txn AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
), all_cust AS (
  SELECT CUST_K FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_no_txn_2025
FROM all_cust a
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cust_with_txn c WHERE c.CUST_K = a.CUST_K);

WITH auth AS (
  SELECT a.PMT_STS_CD1, d.CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS declined_pct
FROM auth;

WITH f AS (
  SELECT f.CMPLT_CTG_K, f.IS_ESCLT, f.BUS_DT_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
  WHERE f.IS_ESCLT = true
), d AS (
  SELECT d.CMPLT_CTG_K, d.DSPLY_NM
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG d
), dt AS (
  SELECT d.DT_K, d.CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT d
)
SELECT d.DSPLY_NM AS category_name, COUNT(*) AS escalated_count
FROM f
JOIN d ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = d.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM dt.CAL_DT) = 2025
GROUP BY d.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY escalated_count DESC;

SELECT SUM(f.TXN_AMT) AS total_fraud_txn_amt
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND f.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD';

WITH a AS (
  SELECT a.AML_ALRT_F_K, a.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1, a.JUR_K, d_dt.CAL_DT, d_jur.DSPLY_NM
  FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR d_jur ON a.JUR_K = d_jur.JUR_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON a.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
  WHERE a.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d_dt.CAL_DT) = 2025
)
SELECT DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name, COUNT(*) AS high_severity_alerts
FROM a
GROUP BY DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY high_severity_alerts DESC;

WITH target AS (
  SELECT DT_K
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE CAL_DT = DATE '2025-08-31'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS loans_over_90
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D d
JOIN target t ON d.BUS_DT_K = t.DT_K
WHERE d.DYS_PST_DUE > 90;

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT f.BUS_DT_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL d ON f.CHNL_K = d.CHNL_K
  WHERE d.DSPLY_NM = 'Mobile App'
)
SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS year, COUNT(*) AS txn_count
FROM txn t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR;

SELECT d.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product, SUM(f.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT) AS total_outstanding
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD d ON f.LN_PRD_K = d.LN_PRD_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT = '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY d.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY total_outstanding DESC;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT f.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
    AND f.IS_CRSS_BRDR = TRUE
    AND c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'SME'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CUST_K) AS distinct_sme_customers
FROM t;

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT d.RGN_CD1, d.DSPLY_NM, COUNT(*) AS txn_cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR d ON f.BR_K = d.BR_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY d.RGN_CD1, d.DSPLY_NM
), ranked AS (
  SELECT rgn_cd1, dsply_nm, txn_cnt,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY rgn_cd1 ORDER BY txn_cnt DESC) AS rn
  FROM txn
)
SELECT rgn_cd1, dsply_nm, txn_cnt
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY rgn_cd1;

WITH auth AS (
  SELECT a.ORGNL_AMT, m.MRCH_CTG_CD1, d.CAL_YR_NBR
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_MRCH m ON a.MRCH_K = m.MRCH_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT MRCH_CTG_CD1, SUM(ORGNL_AMT) AS total_amount
FROM auth
GROUP BY MRCH_CTG_CD1
ORDER BY total_amount DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT f.CUST_K, d.BUS_ID, SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_amt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ddt ON f.BUS_DT_K = ddt.DT_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST d ON f.CUST_K = d.CUST_K
  WHERE ddt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY f.CUST_K, d.BUS_ID
)
SELECT BUS_ID, total_amt
FROM t
ORDER BY total_amt DESC
LIMIT 5;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT f.CCY_CD1, f.AMT, d.CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT CCY_CD1, SUM(CAST(AMT AS NUMERIC(20,4))) AS total_amount
FROM t
GROUP BY CCY_CD1
ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

WITH wire AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON w.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
), atm AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_customers
FROM (
  SELECT CUST_K FROM wire
  INTERSECT
  SELECT CUST_K FROM atm
) t;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT f.WR_TRF_F_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfers_2025
FROM t;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS yr, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
)
SELECT yr, cnt FROM t ORDER BY yr;

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT f.BUS_DT_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.IS_WKND THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS weekend_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN NOT d.IS_WKND THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS weekday_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH bal AS (
  SELECT ACCT_K, BUS_DT_K, CLSNG_BAL_AMT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D
  WHERE BUS_DT_K IN (
    SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT IN ('2025-12-31','2025-06-30')
  )
),
  dec AS (
    SELECT a.ACCT_K
    FROM bal a
    JOIN bal b ON a.ACCT_K = b.ACCT_K
    WHERE a.BUS_DT_K = (SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT='2025-12-31')
      AND b.BUS_DT_K = (SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT='2025-06-30')
      AND a.CLSNG_BAL_AMT < 0.9 * b.CLSNG_BAL_AMT
  )
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_accounts FROM dec;

WITH c AS (
  SELECT d.DSPLY_NM AS category,
         EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (f.RSLTN_AT - f.CNTCT_STRTD_AT))/86400 AS days
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG d ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = d.CMPLT_CTG_K
  WHERE f.IS_RSLVD = true
    AND DATE_TRUNC('year', f.RSLTN_AT) = DATE '2025-01-01'
)
SELECT category, AVG(days) AS avg_days
FROM c
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY avg_days;

WITH curr AS (
  SELECT * FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST WHERE IS_CURR = true
), prev AS (
  SELECT * FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST WHERE IS_CURR = false
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_with_segment_change
FROM curr c
JOIN prev p
  ON c.CUST_K = p.CUST_K
 AND p.VRSN_NBR = c.VRSN_NBR - 1
WHERE c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 <> p.CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

WITH txns AS (
  SELECT f.CUST_K, d.QTR_NBR
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers
FROM (
  SELECT CUST_K
  FROM txns
  GROUP BY CUST_K
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT QTR_NBR) = 4
) q;

WITH disputes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT d
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
), transfers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF t
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON t.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers
FROM disputes d
LEFT JOIN transfers t ON d.CUST_K = t.CUST_K
WHERE t.CUST_K IS NULL;

WITH d4 AS (
  SELECT LN_ID
  FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT = '2024-06-30' AND f.DYS_PST_DUE = 0
), d5 AS (
  SELECT LN_ID
  FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT = '2025-06-30' AND f.DYS_PST_DUE > 30
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM d4
WHERE LN_ID IN (SELECT LN_ID FROM d5);

WITH transfers AS (
  SELECT f.CCY_CD1, f.STLM_AMT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025
)
SELECT CCY_CD1,
       PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY STLM_AMT) AS median_amount
FROM transfers
GROUP BY CCY_CD1;

WITH mobile_txn AS (
  SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS yr, COUNT(*) AS txn_cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON t.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE c.DSPLY_NM = 'Mobile App'
  GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
)
SELECT (m2025.txn_cnt::numeric / NULLIF(m2024.txn_cnt,0) - 1) * 100 AS pct_growth
FROM mobile_txn m2024
JOIN mobile_txn m2025 ON m2024.yr = 2024 AND m2025.yr = 2025;

WITH last_snap AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', to_date(BUS_DT_K::text,'YYYYMMDD')) AS month_start,
         MAX(SNAP_TMSTM) AS last_snap
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM to_date(BUS_DT_K::text,'YYYYMMDD'))=2025
  GROUP BY 1
), balances AS (
  SELECT l.month_start,
         SUM(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS total_closing_balance
  FROM last_snap l
  JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
    ON DATE_TRUNC('month', to_date(f.BUS_DT_K::text,'YYYYMMDD'))=l.month_start
   AND f.SNAP_TMSTM=l.last_snap
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM month_start) AS month,
       total_closing_balance
FROM balances
ORDER BY month_start;

WITH cust2025 AS (
  SELECT CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
  WHERE IS_CURR = true
    AND CUST_SNC_DT BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
), tx2025 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_customers
FROM cust2025 c
JOIN tx2025 t ON c.CUST_K = t.CUST_K;

WITH active AS (
  SELECT CUST_K, CUST_SGMNT_CD1
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
  WHERE DATE '2023-06-30' BETWEEN EFF_FRM_DT AND COALESCE(EFF_TO_DT, DATE '9999-12-31')
)
SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment, COUNT(DISTINCT CUST_K) AS customer_count
FROM active
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY segment;

WITH f AS (
  SELECT f.CUST_K, f.ORGNL_AMT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
), s AS (
  SELECT c.CUST_K, c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1, c.BUS_ID, SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_amt
  FROM f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
  WHERE c.IS_CURR = true
  GROUP BY c.CUST_K, c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1, c.BUS_ID
)
SELECT segment, bus_id, total_amt
FROM (
  SELECT s.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment, s.BUS_ID AS bus_id, s.total_amt,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 ORDER BY s.total_amt DESC) AS rn
  FROM s
) t
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY segment, total_amt DESC;

WITH total AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
) 
SELECT
  f.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
  COUNT(*) AS transfer_count,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / total.cnt, 2) AS pct_of_total
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
CROSS JOIN total
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1, total.cnt
ORDER BY pct_of_total DESC;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', d.CAL_DT) AS month_start,
    COUNT(*) AS transfers
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT >= '2025-01-01' AND d.CAL_DT < '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY month_start
)
SELECT
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM month_start)::int AS month_num,
  transfers,
  SUM(transfers) OVER (ORDER BY month_start) AS running_total
FROM t
ORDER BY month_start;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT f.ORGNL_AMT, f.ORGNL_CCY_CD1, d.CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT SUM(
  CASE WHEN t.ORGNL_CCY_CD1 = 'EUR' THEN t.ORGNL_AMT
       ELSE t.ORGNL_AMT * fx.MID_RT END
) AS total_eur
FROM t
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D fx
  ON fx.BUS_DT_K = (SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT d2 WHERE d2.CAL_DT = t.CAL_DT)
  AND fx.QUOT_CCY_CD1 = t.ORGNL_CCY_CD1
  AND fx.BS_CCY_CD1 = 'EUR';

WITH auth AS (
  SELECT d.MTH_NBR, d.CAL_YR_NBR,
         COUNT(*) AS total,
         SUM(CASE WHEN f.RJCTN_RSN_CD1 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS declined
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR, d.MTH_NBR
)
SELECT MTH_NBR, ROUND(100.0*declined/total,2) AS declined_pct
FROM auth
ORDER BY declined_pct DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH f AS (
  SELECT f.STLM_AMT, f.CCY_CD1, d.CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025
)
SELECT CCY_CD1, SUM(STLM_AMT) AS total_volume
FROM f
GROUP BY CCY_CD1
ORDER BY total_volume DESC;
